summary_paragraph: Mr. ___ was admitted after an unwitnessed fall while intoxicated, presenting with chest pain. Imaging revealed six left-sided rib fractures and a small, stable left apical pneumothorax that resolved without intervention. He experienced transient confusion that resolved with supportive care. On hospital day two, he developed abdominal distension and vomiting; a KUB showed gastric distention, prompting NG tube placement, which was removed the following day after improvement. His pain was managed with a transition from PCA morphine to oral oxycodone. His multiple myeloma was stable, though his platelet count was low, leading to temporary discontinuation of warfarin. He was discharged to a sub-acute rehabilitation facility with instructions for pain management, incentive spirometry, and follow-up with his oncology team.
